description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER's options blob terminates with the End Option (0xFF) at the last position (RFC 2131 §4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The options blob is a TLV stream — the parser walks until 0xFF (End Option). Without that terminator, receivers walk past the buffer or treat trailing zeros as garbage options. RFC 2131 §4.1 makes the End Option mandatory.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • last byte of options blob == 0xFF   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER's options blob ends with 0xFF.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_last_option_not_end — last byte is not 0xFF
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DISCOVER options blob ends with End Option — normal
verdicts.Fail_last_option_not_end: DUT DHCPDISCOVER last option is not End
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
